In 2015 Kate is single, aged 63, and in receipt of a small private pension. Kate is entitled to SPC and because she reached State Pension age before 6.4.16 she may also be entitled to receive Savings Credit when she attains the age of 65 in 2017.

Kate’s twin brother Jason is single, retired and also in receipt of a small private pension. Jason is entitled to SPC but because he has not reached State Pension age before 6.4.16 he will not be entitled to receive Savings Credit when he attains the age of 65 in 2017.
